visual_action: A montage of scenes from the 2025 Kennedy Center Honors, presented as being hosted by President Donald Trump. The video shows Trump and Melania Trump on the red carpet, Trump speaking at a podium on a grand stage, and both watching from a presidential box in a theater. The event features various honorees, including individuals resembling Sylvester Stallone, Gloria Gaynor, George Strait, and members of the band KISS, who are shown receiving applause, performing, or being celebrated. The video ends with a title card for "THE WHITE HOUSE".
